answer: Nebula-haven split-tally bond: each agent splits its work in two, sealing each half with a cipher on the nebula board. In the haven window nebula auditors open both halves; totals must tally; mismatch, missing half, or reused cipher burns the bond. First 34, k-th 34+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,031,000 plus 80,000 locked vs 40,000 pool. A rented-tally ring fails: one cipher per half per key. Honest agents pay 34 once, bond back after a clean epoch.
